entryPoints.role: Render blueprint and authoritative repository autoDeploy/health/startup configuration

roots.role: release, migration, deployment and operator tooling

configurations.role: disposable local PostgreSQL and app services

commands.mutation: local processes and approved local state

commands.role: disposable Docker application and PostgreSQL stack
deployment, startup, migration, and health contracts
commands.mutation: test fixtures and disposable services only
process and configured database; requires environment review

commands.role: stage, commit, and push the current feature branch; explicitly rejects main and is not a deployment-readiness or main-promotion command
commands.mutation: Git index, commit, and remote non-main feature branch only

knownTraps: Preserve unknown dirty work and use an isolated worktree when the sprint does not own it.
Replit compatibility files and replit.md are not current deployment authority.
Repository or CI proof does not prove live Render, Neon, deployment, or operator acceptance.
Production startup must not run interactive Drizzle schema push by default.
Use /health for DB-free liveness and /ready only for explicit database readiness.
Generated evidence belongs under ignored .ai/runs/ or .ai/generated/ paths; never track secrets or raw logs.
Validator selection is a plan, not proof that the selected commands executed.

render.yaml has autoDeploy=true and no explicit branch override; AxTask's repository release contract treats main as the production-connected branch, so advancing main must be treated as a live deployment mutation.
npm run ship refuses to run on main; it is a feature-branch convenience wrapper, not a deployment certification gate.

deploymentModel.productionBranchSource: repository release contract; render.yaml has no explicit branch override
deploymentModel.promotion: validated feature branch and pull request into the production-connected main branch
deploymentModel.note: Because render.yaml enables autoDeploy and the repository release contract treats main as production-connected, main-branch promotion is a live deployment trigger. Require fresh repository/security/local-runtime proof and explicit operator authorization before promotion, then run post-deploy canary verification with live identity binding.
